name: terminal-notify
description: Desktop notifications through your terminal when Codex finishes, asks a question or needs a permission. From the makers of Agent Terminal (https://4nuva.dev/agent-terminal/), which also forwards them to your phone.

interface.longDescription: Raises a desktop notification through your terminal when Codex finishes a turn, asks a question or needs a permission. Picks OSC 777, 9 or 99 for your terminal.
